releases.name: Version 2.2.1
releases.body: - Fixed a bug where the ship log splash screen would stay stuck on until a scout photo was taken
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了一个问题，即飞船日志的启动画面会一直卡住，直到拍摄了一张侦察照片

releases.name: Version 2.2.0
releases.body:
- Fixed a bug where quitting to main menu while in 3rd person makes you levitate on the ground unable to move when you reload.
- Added translation support for options and button prompts
- Added French translations (probably bad)
- Added option to hide/show button prompts and also checks the base game button prompt setting (thanks Owen for the PR that I forgot about for 1 year)
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了一个在第三人称模式下退出到主菜单，然后重新加载时会导致玩家悬浮在地面上无法移动的bug。
- 添加了对选项和按钮提示的翻译支持
- 添加了法语翻译（可能不太好）
- 添加了隐藏/显示按钮提示的选项，并且会检查基础游戏的按钮提示设置（感谢 Owen 提交的 PR，我竟然忘了长达一年之久）

releases.name: Version 2.1.1
releases.body: - Add Patreon donation link to mod manifest
releases.bodyZh: - 在模组清单中添加Patreon捐赠链接

releases.name: Version 2.1.0
releases.body:
- Fixed errors due to patch 14
- Using the ship log no longer kicks your out of third person
- Fixed notifications overlapping on-screen text
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了补丁14导致的错误
- 使用飞船日志不再将你踢出第三人称视角
- 修复了屏幕上的通知与文字重叠的问题

releases.name: v2.0.3
releases.body:
- Update to patch 13
- Update to use new Common Camera API
releases.bodyZh:
- 更新至补丁13
- 更新以使用新的Common Camera API

releases.name: v2.0.2
releases.body:
- Added log level option
- Updated packages
- Fix SwitchActiveCamera event not firing (was stopping CCU from fixing stuff when using other camera mods)

releases.name: v2.0.1
releases.body: - Improved input handling (pre-emptive OWO recorder writing compatibility)

releases.name: v2.0.0
releases.body:
- Updated to use Common Camera Utility
- Added button prompts
- Fixed an issue where you'd go into third person when using the probe launcher.
